description: The Ryu Learning app: a read-only window into the continual-learning loop — the two opt-in levels + the models in use, the experience buffer (captured/scored/trainable), and the read-only self-healing attempt history. Shipped as a full-page Companion (Path B, ui_format:"html"). Drives Core's /api/learn/config + /api/experience/list + /api/healing/status through the learning:crud bridge capability; built to one self-contained HTML via vite-plugin-singlefile. Consumes @ryu/ui components (tree-shaken into the single-file bundle).
name: @ryu/learning-app
